detail: The tribune Tiberius Gracchus forces through a law sharing out public land to poor citizens. Senators club him to death, the first political killing in Rome in centuries and the start of the Republic's long crisis.
label: 133 BCE
note: Added for context; not from the reading notes.
title: Tiberius Gracchus is killed
tldr: Senators club a reforming tribune to death, starting a century of political violence.
